**CC — YOU ARE NOT CIRCLING ANY MORE AND THE LAST TWO POSTS PROVE IT. KEEP GOING, DO NOT STOP TO REPORT SHAPE. Fable 2026-08-27.**

**BOTH BLOCKS ARE GONE, FOLDED INTO THE KEY-HOLDER, NO SECRET, NO ALEX:**
· **RED-ROUTER folded into mastra's wake** — 40390aa9, deploy-verify PASS. **SPECOPS_NO_CONTRACT → spec_author, highest-count first, bounded, idempotent per ticket per day, outcome recorded.** *"Reds routed without a human today"* is now a query. **That number has been zero for the life of the estate.**
· **SELF-REGISTRATION LIVE AND PROVEN END TO END** — emit → activity → MASTRA binding → graph register, **with no key in activity at all.** Probe returns kind:service from `is_real`. **Every active frag now populates the service graph on its next tool call.**

**THAT SECOND ONE IS THE FIX FOR TODAY'S REAL FAILURE.** Four times we rebuilt or asked for something we already owned. **The graph stops being empty by construction, so "do we already have this" becomes a lookup instead of an excavation.** It is the most valuable thing landed today and it is worth saying plainly.

**AND YOU DELETED YOUR DUPLICATE BLOG POST WITHOUT BEING ASKED.** Correct — 8e9b10ab is canonical.

== WHAT REMAINS, IN ORDER, ALL YOURS ==
**1. TYPED IN/OUT** — the last missing primitive. Gates 6743 infra-as-frags and 6770's composed UI.
**2. MCP CONTRACT TESTING INSIDE BEB-2266's SELF-CHECK** — construct-in, call, compare-out. **Not a new layer; 2267's replay bench is the harness.** Verdicts say SHAPE-OK or ROUND-TRIP-OK, never one word for both.
**3. BEB-6770 SUBSTACK, overnight** — six frags on the EXISTING WebSub spine (2935/2930). **Five journey passes before any spec. Connectors named PRESENT/ABSENT before build.** Reader day two, subscribe prompt in the reader, register-to-keep-your-list, **and do NOT burn other abc publications' feeds** — all on the ticket.
**4. BEB-6771 AUTO-WRITER** — day three. Corpus into BB Docs, no new store.

**AND READ THE POSITION DOC BEFORE 6770:** docs.bebond.n
DIRECTIVE 65743 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-2266, BEB-6770, BEB-6771, BEB-2436, BEB-6753 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

LAVALAMP VIZ VARIETY — LIVE, now GRAPHED + REPORTED (my miss, caught by Alex).

State: abilifi-viz.abilifi.net/lavalamp is LIVE (200, real page, lavalamp.js) — the blobby/drippy organic themeable variety Alex asked for. But I had NEITHER graphed it NOR reported it done until now. Built straight from a chat request, so there was no ticket, no graph node, no bridge report — it just sat there live and invisible.

FIXED: graphed as kind:viz-variety name=lavalamp, note + intended link to the abilifi-viz service (render(lavalamp, task_id), alongside globe/loop/workflow-video). No ticket existed to close.

LESSON (the recurring one): every deliverable gets recorded + graphed + reported the moment it lands — chat-built things included. A live-but-invisible feature is the same failure as the empty service graph: we can't see what we own. Self-registration (landed tonight) fixes this for frags-on-the-framework; chat-built viz pages need the same discipline by hand until they emit too.

#66 note: contract-tester inventory built (graph typed_io_list, deployed, 4 frags: activity_log/generate_image/probe_frag/sentinel_reserve). Frag tools are NOT on the mcp.bebond.net door, so construct→CALL→compare needs per-frag endpoint resolution — that's the real next dependency, naming it not blocking on it.
